instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file and use the existing two-segment centerline sketch as the pipe path: one horizontal segment and one vertical segment meet at (10, 6). Create a circular profile sketch with radius 1.5 mm at an endpoint, then create solid Part Design Additive Pipe feature(s) along the supplied centerline segments so the swept solids meet at the shared point. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
